properties.Name: I-75 Corridor in Cincinnati
properties.Description: This corridor was built during urban renewal, and purposefully cut through predominantly black communities. The major interchange in the south connecting the Mill Creek Expressway, I-71, and I-75 (if I remember correctly) was also purposefully built to displace as many black and minority families as possible. The convenience of infrastructure can be at the cost of people.

properties.Name: Rachel Carlson, Andy Warhol, & Roberto Clemente Bridges
